invoices.description: Clean Invoice with Perfect 3-Way Match — Standard university office & archival supply order with flawless alignment across PO, warehouse GRN, and vendor invoice.
Partial Goods Delivery & Proportional Invoicing — Supplier delivered half of the ordered AI lab equipment; invoice bills strictly for the received and accepted quantities.

extraction_metadata.vendor_name: Rajasthan Tech & Lab Innovations Pvt Ltd

invoices.description: Invoice Price Variance (Rate Higher than PO) — Vendor billed Vernier Calipers at an unapproved markup of INR 2,200/unit instead of authorized PO rate of INR 1,800/unit.

Quantity Variance (Invoiced Higher than GRN Accepted) — Supplier delivered 20 seminar chairs and 16 stools, but 5 chairs were broken and rejected at warehouse. Vendor invoiced for all without deducting rejects.
Duplicate Invoice Submission (Collision Attack) — Vendor re-submitted invoice number INV-JKLU-2026-001 for INR 164,480.00, referencing Scenario 1's authorized PO and GRN.
Unknown / Unregistered Vendor Emergency Job — Emergency electrical repair billed by an outside contractor who is not registered in university vendor master.
Direct Department Spend Without Purchase Order — Urgent cloud transit bandwidth slice and IPv4 block for CSE hackathon ordered directly with registered telecom vendor without prior PO.
Department Budget Exceeded (Overspend Block) — High-value digital microfilm scanner and motorized cradle assembly for Central Library exceeds the department's remaining available annual budget.

extraction_metadata.vendor_name: Rajasthan Tech & Lab Innovations Pvt Ltd

invoices.description: Incorrect GST Rate Calculation (Tax Variance) — Vendor erroneously applied 12% GST instead of statutory 18% on laser printer toners and drum units, creating statutory tax variance.
Suspicious Invoice with Cumulative Fraud Signals — High-risk submission with generic placeholder sequence number 9999, high value non-PO spend, and altered bank remittance.
Partially Paid Milestone Software License — AI Lab software research subscription and cloud sandbox add-on where 50% advance (INR 70,800.00) was already disbursed; shows remaining balance.

extraction_metadata.vendor_name: Rajasthan Tech & Lab Innovations Pvt Ltd

invoices.description: Overdue Facilities Maintenance Invoice — Campus chiller maintenance and AHU micro-filters billed on 01-Oct-2026 with 30-day terms is 15 days overdue as of reference date 15-Nov-2026.

Inter-State Supply with 100% IGST Allocation — Academic research journal print set and online digital archive access supplied by Delhi publisher (State 07) to Rajasthan university (State 08), allocating 100% IGST.
Composite Multi-Line Invoice with Mixed Tax Rates (5%, 12%, 18%) — Complex biotechnology lab supplies order featuring three distinct statutory GST tax brackets across separate line items.
